about_the_game:
A cozy pig farm simulator where life flows peacefully — but not without surprises.

You inherit your very first piglet and an old rusty tub. Everything seems simple… until your pigs start digging up strange objects. It looks like Grandpa left behind more than just a piglet.

But for now — just live. Watch your piggies sleep, dig, and snort in delight. Care for them, wash them, decorate them, collect coins, and grow your herd.

🐷 The Life of a Piggy:

• Piggies roam around on their own, sleeping, eating, and digging

• Sometimes they find coins or unexpected items

• They jump into mud and get messy from head to curly tail

🍎 Loving Care:

• Offer them an apple if they get hungry

• Got dirty? Throw in some firewood, heat up the tub, and give them a proper bath: broom, bubbles, bucket — all by the book

• And oh, what sweet clean piggies they become after a bath!

🛁 Growth and Cuteness:

• Buy new pigs — each one is unique and charming in their own way

• Upgrade their comforts: swap the tub for a bathtub or even build a full pool

• Dress them up: bows, hats, or maybe even stylish sunglasses?

🧩 Grandpa's Secret:

• Your pigs can dig up more than just coins

• Among the finds are mysterious artifacts

• Collect them all to uncover a long-lost story

• What did Grandpa bury… and why?

Dirty Piggy is a game you’ll want to check in on every day.

Let your piggies live their lives — you just stay close.

Care, coziness, and a little bit of mystery — all in one screen.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Pentium G3220
  • Memory: 300 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti

short_description: A cozy idle game about cute pigs, care and little discoveries. Feed, wash, decorate, collect coins and strange finds. They say grandpa hid something... Are you and the pigs really going to solve a family secret?
supported_languages: English, German, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Japanese
